verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote as the clear, large focal point with the attribution subordinate, and the jar sits neatly in its circle. However, the SOLSTICE logo floats in the middle of the text column instead of lining up with the left edge, and the quote mark has shrunk too much. B inverts the hierarchy: the attribution is bigger and bolder than the quote, which has shrunk to secondary size. Its logo sits at an arbitrary spot at the top that doesn't line up with the text, and the oversized jar sticks out of its circle, so the right side looks unbalanced.
